stops.name: Viamala Raststätte Thusis
stops.quote: The successful concept of the Viamala Raststätte Thusis is based on the philosophy of winning the favor of guests by using local products and serving guests with personal contact and friendliness.
stops.english: The successful concept of the Viamala Raststätte Thusis is based on the philosophy of winning the favor of guests by using local products and serving guests with personal contact and friendliness.

stops.name: Photo Spot Viamala Gorge
stops.quote: The Viamala gorge lies near the historical viaSpluga transit route, one of the many roads that led to Rome in ancient times.
stops.english: The Viamala gorge lies near the historical viaSpluga transit route, one of the many roads that led to Rome in ancient times.

stops.name: TCS Camping Thusis Viamala
stops.quote: Welcome to the mystical heart of Graubünden at the northern entrance to the spectacular Viamala Gorge, carved out of the rock thousands of years ago by glacial ice and the Hinter Rhine River.
stops.english: Welcome to the mystical heart of Graubünden at the northern entrance to the spectacular Viamala Gorge, carved out of the rock thousands of years ago by glacial ice and the Hinter Rhine River.

stops.name: Restaurant Viamala
stops.quote: Enjoy a snack or dinner at the camp's own restaurant Viamala and end the beautiful summer evenings with a glass of wine or a cool drink on the terrace.
stops.english: Enjoy a snack or dinner at the camp's own restaurant Viamala and end the beautiful summer evenings with a glass of wine or a cool drink on the terrace.

stops.name: ViaSpluga
stops.quote: This trail is 65km long and runs from Thusis through the Viamala Gorge, the Roffla Gorge and on stone paths over Splügen Pass to Chiavenna.
stops.english: This trail is 65km long and runs from Thusis through the Viamala Gorge, the Roffla Gorge and on stone paths over Splügen Pass to Chiavenna.

stops.name: Dorfführung Thusis
stops.quote: Geführter Rundgang durch den Handelsort am Eingang zur Viamala-Schlucht.
stops.english: Guided tour through the trading town at the entrance to the Viamala Gorge.
